newsitem.title: USA: US House negotiators to stick to de minimis plan.
newsitem.headline: US House negotiators to stick to de minimis plan.

text.p: U.S. House tax conferees will tell Senate negotiators Friday that they will not back down on their proposal to broadly scale back the two-percent de minimis rule, a knowledgeable industry source said.
The statement will appear in a new counteroffer that House conferees are expected to forward to Senate negotiators later Friday, said the source, who asked not to be identified.

The development is bad news to the municipal bond market whose issuers and dealers strongly oppose the House plan to radically cut back the de minimis exemption for corporate holdings of munis to a flat $1 million.

House conferees started the negotiating process on July 15 with a 27-page document that made few concessions to Senate negotiators. There was no offer, for instance, to drop the House's tough de minimis plan.
Senators responded July 17 with a detailed counteroffer in which they refused to accept the House provision.
